peoples_entry.name: Frogmen
peoples_entry.note: Batrachian Confederacies of the SW Highlands (`Jrrmiah`, `Trrmb-Pillar`, `Krrmt`, `Rrrmk-Spring` — LORE.md §6.22): compact 0.95x plantigrade amphibians (`mod_head_frog` with dorsal eye turrets, gular vocal pouch, and webbed hands) respiring partly through brush-oiled skin. Dressed in `bead-cone` cocoon silk, `opal-shell` ammolite mosaic, wet-sphagnum hydration cuffs, polypore bracket leather, flooded-bore `ancient-alloys`, and `Span` Thunderdome prize-bronze (14 M/F paired tiers; tools/garments/cultures/frogmen.py).
